substrate: hivemind toy: 3 binary substrates × 1 cell, 8-state, coupling K via XOR cell density
method: 3-source net co-information II_3 per cell; sign convention II_3 > 0 = synergy, II_3 < 0 = redundancy (3-source / odd-parity; opposite of 2-source II_c in H_294)
pid_definition: net McGill 3-variate co-information = ΣI(T;S_i) - ΣI(T;S_i,S_j) + I(T;S_0,S_1,S_2). Net summary, NOT full Williams-Beer 18-atom trivariate PID lattice.
K_dependency: synergy strictly monotone increasing in K (XOR cell density): 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 across K {0, 0.33, 0.67, 1.0}
verdict_summary: collective-Φ flow is synergy-dominant across the K sweep (mean synergy_ratio = 1.0 on 8 permutations × 4 K-buckets). XOR-coupled hivemind cells produce pure-synergy net co-information; identity cells produce zero net co-info (pure unique-info). Redundancy = 0 throughout (XOR-family substrate, sources independent under uniform ensemble).
honest_limits: L1: net 3-source co-info (NOT full 18-atom Williams-Beer trivariate PID lattice; only net synergy/redundancy summary, mirrors H_294 net II_c approach)
L2: XOR-family substrate ⇒ redundancy is identically 0 (sources independent under uniform ensemble). Redundancy>0 substrate (copy/majority hivemind) needed for symmetric test
L3: small substrate (3 × 1-cell binary; 8 source states); larger n hivemind needs separate verify
L4: deterministic permutation enumeration (8 masks total), not stochastic seeds — robustness comes from K-monotonicity across the full mask set, not multi-seed RNG variance

L5: PID sign-convention sensitivity (MMI vs Idtxl vs Bertschinger). McGill net co-info chosen for 0-axiom continuity with H_294; alternative definitions could relabel net synergy magnitudes (but not direction across the K monotone)
L6: toy substrate = flow proxy, NOT phenomenal collective consciousness
L7: collective Φ NOT directly measured here — claim is about the PID structure of the cross-substrate information flow, sister to H_290/293/294 which all bear the same caveat
